_comment: PKI NODE USB ONLY. Default user accounts belong on the pki node's KEYS stick (the config node). Worker nodes (backend/frontend/host) carry keys only — no users.json — and rely on the build-time fallback user + break-glass ssh/root.authorized_keys; operators manage them via the cluster.
_comment_root: HARDENED DEFAULT: root login is LOCKED. gen-provision-keys.sh leaves password_hash empty + locked:true unless --root-password (or GEN_ROOT_PASSWORD=true) is given, in which case it stores a SALTED+HASHED password here (never plaintext) and sets locked:false. provision.sh runs `passwd -l root` when locked/empty. Operators reach the node via the privileged user over Tailscale SSH (break-glass ssh/root.authorized_keys on worker sticks).
